map.柔韧性测试器，按坐位体前屈成绩对照年龄性别标准求百分等级与柔韧等级，辅助体能评估: The flexibility tester converts sit-and-reach performance against age- and sex-specific standards into a percentile rank and flexibility grade, aiding fitness assessment.
map.体测评级：输入成绩，算百分等级与柔韧等级，快速出结果。: Fitness test grading: enter the score, compute percentile and flexibility grade, quick result.
map.训练前后对比：两次测试看百分等级变化，量化柔韧进步。: Before/after training comparison: two tests show percentile-rank change, quantifying flexibility progress.
map.群体筛查：批量录入成绩看分布，定位需加强训练的个体。: Group screening: enter scores in bulk to see the distribution and locate individuals needing more training.
map.：男、20 岁、坐位体前屈 18cm，对照国民体质标准百分等级约 75、柔韧等级: : male, 20 years, sit-and-reach 18 cm, against the national fitness standard percentile about 75, flexibility grade 'good'; after 8 weeks of training up to 22 cm, percentile about 85.
map.标准来源是什么？: What is the source of the standard?
map.依据国民体质监测相关标准，按年龄与性别分组对照。: Based on national fitness monitoring standards, grouped by age and sex for comparison.
map.数据要上传吗？: Does data need to be uploaded?
map.不需要。成绩仅在本地处理，不上传。: Not needed. Scores are processed locally only, not uploaded.
map.等级能用于医学判断吗？: Can the grade be used for medical judgment?
map.仅作体能参考，不替代医学或康复专业评估。: Only a fitness reference, not replacing medical or rehabilitation professional assessment.
